notes.craft: Canada Goose's own FY25 Modern Slavery Act report says its core down jackets are made in seven owned and operated factories in Winnipeg, Toronto, Scarborough and Montreal, and that 75% of products by volume are made in Canada; it also owns its Romanian knitwear maker (Paola Confectii, 2023). Parka pages say 'made in canada'; knit, footwear and toque pages say only 'made in europe'. The brand is the maker for its core range: a 5, at the 4/5 border because footwear, rainwear and accessories are made by unnamed partners.

craft_evidence.owned_d: Brand-owned (Canada Goose Holdings), not a parent group's. FY25 Modern Slavery Act report (S-211): 'Our core down-filled jackets are made in our seven owned and operated Canadian manufacturing facilities (Winnipeg, Toronto, Scarborough, and Montreal)'; 75% of products made in Canada, 23% Europe, 2% Asia by volume; rainwear, knitwear, footwear and accessories made in Europe/Asia. Owns the operating assets of Paola Confectii, a Romanian knitwear maker (acquired Nov 2023; had made HyBridge knits for CG since 2017 — FashionNetwork, WWD). COO quoted (Supply Chain Dive, 2025): over 90% of down-filled outerwear made in the company's Canadian facilities. Our History page: seven facilities, three GTA, three Winnipeg, one Quebec. Owned making covers down outerwear and (via Romania) knitwear; footwear, rainwear and most accessories are third-party.
craft_evidence.countries: Canada 3/8 (Langford parka, Expedition parka, Waist Pack), Europe 5/8 (HyBridge Knit Jacket, Rosseau sweater, Keystone boot, Cascade sneaker, Rib toque) — European pages say only 'made in europe', no country. Sample of 8 PDPs: parkas, knitwear, footwear, accessories. All 8 stated an origin.
